restaurant.prompt: Edit this exact KayKit sample promotional image into a flat Catchline PALETTE STUDY. Preserve absolutely every object, geometry, composition, camera, object position, logo and typography, black background, lighting and shadow. ONLY recolour the orange table tops, orange chair seats/backs, orange stool tops and orange kitchen counter tops to honey painted timber (#C58B50, highlights #DFB77A, shadow #8C5A36), clean broad low-poly surface without grain. Change the mint fridge shells and mint lower wall panels to restrained restaurant teal #168F9F with lighter teal highlights. Red oven shell becomes navy #173F57. White cabinet doors become warm cream #F4EFE3. Preserve ALL FOOD unchanged in natural colours: carrots orange, tomatoes red, cheese yellow, buns tan, lettuce green, meat pink/brown. All stainless steel appliances/legs/sink/extractor stay light steel grey; all glass unchanged blue. This is a colour-only mock over the existing sample, not a redesign. Do not add decorations or people. Return a single recoloured sample image.
